card.line: Beer, meaning "well," was a place where Israel received water from the LORD in the wilderness, and later a place where Jotham found safety.

moments.title: The well at Beer
moments.text: Israel came to Beer, the well where the LORD told Moses to gather the people so He could give them water. Israel sang to the well, which the princes and nobles had dug.

moments.title: Jotham runs to Beer
moments.text: After Jotham spoke his warning, he ran away to Beer. He lived there because he feared his brother Abimelech.
